description: Return the appropriate intent-spec template (blank, Level-1 MVR, or full 9-section) with optional pre-filled objective_hint, autonomy_level, and agent_name. Use this when starting a new agent/skill or retrofitting an existing one.

agent_name.description: Optional agent/skill name. Used in the YAML header.

autonomy_level.description: Optional autonomy level. Pre-fills the Decision Authority section with the matching architecture pattern.

kind.description: Which scaffold to return. 'blank' = empty 9-section template; 'level-1-mvr' = 3-section minimum-viable retrofit; 'full-9-section' = full template with prompts.

objective_hint.description: Optional one-sentence hint about what the agent should do. Pre-fills the objective field with a starter draft.

name: generate_intent_spec_scaffold
title: Generate Intent Spec Scaffold
